claims.text: the NemoClaw-Thor fast recipe (serving/docs/QWEN38-FLASH-NEXT-FAST-THOR.md, commit 9c9c0873, 2026-09-06) is the starting recipe: RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 @7b719225, gpu_mem_util 0.90, BF16 KV, max_model_len 262144, max_num_seqs 4, embedded MTP n=3, fused SM110a GDN CUDA decode, flashinfer_cutlass MoE, PLE mmap MADV_RANDOM + parallel reads; its reported numbers (34.98 tok/s single-stream mean, 677,323 KV tokens / 2.58x, 68.10 tok/s 4-way short) are the author's, NOT yet reproduced here

the served image is a 3-layer LOCAL build pinned by sha: blazux/qwen3.8-Flash-DGX @4b723de2 (DET_ARCH=110a) -> Dockerfile.qwen38-flash-next-sm110 (SM110 flashinfer_cutlass MoE gate patch) -> Dockerfile.qwen38-flash-next-gdn-sm110 (vLLM @082cf021 fused GDN decode kernel, PR #53835 merged 2026-09-05, + PLE I/O patch); every sha and the resulting image ID are recorded in docs/image-ledger.md, following the lobes/vllm-gemma4:local precedent

pin, don't follow upstream: blazux/qwen3.8-Flash-DGX main is already 32 commits past the recipe's 4b723de2 pin (pushed 2026-09-13, incl. a 'temporary' block-fp8 MTP shim pending vllm#55513); the reproduction uses the recipe's pins, and a re-pin is a separate measured change

the 2026-08-27 lobes conclusion that RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 cannot fit the Thor ('135 GB, SGLang-only, misses by ~13 GB'; VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD a no-op on unified memory) is SUPERSEDED as a premise: the preview vLLM serves it with VLLM_PLE_MMAP=1 mapping the FP8 PLE table from NVMe, and HF reports the pinned revision at 126.0 GiB over 419 files

disk must be reclaimed before the checkpoint download: the Thor's single NVMe (WD SN5000S 1 TB) has 146 GB free against a 126 GiB checkpoint plus three new ~30 GB image layers; docker reports 105.9 GB reclaimable images and 52.7 GB reclaimable build cache

the non-lobes stack on the Thor (culture-nodes prod-api/worker/scheduler/notifier, postgres:17, minio, backup) is not part of this work and is not stopped; it holds ~0.6 GiB resident, which counts against the recipe's 0.90 util and its ~7.2 GiB post-run available-memory margin

dropping lobes on the Thor removes the mesh's only worker host: the Spark reaches model=worker by proxy to the Thor (validated 2026-09-11), so for the window model=worker is unavailable mesh-wide, and restoring it means re-raising the captured thor-worker deployment

no new Colleague role and no role re-point in this scope: Flash-Next lands, if at all, as a catalog candidate; docs/colleague-stack.md says a different checkpoint is a catalog change and adding a role is effectively irreversible, and both 2026-08-27 specs recorded the same non-goal

integrating it as a lobes lane would touch: lobes/catalog.py (new engine=vllm candidate with moe_backend flashinfer_cutlass + MTP speculative_config; SupportedModel has no image field), lobes/templates/fleet/docker-compose.yml (vllm-primary has NO per-lane image override — only VLLM_NIGHTLY_IMAGE; vllm-worker has WORKER_IMAGE — and none passes the VLLM_PLE_*/VLLM_QSA_*/compile-cache env or -cc.splitting_ops), and a new solo Thor shape, since 0.90 util can't co-reside with thor-worker's lanes

open_vagueness.text: vision: the checkpoint declares vision_config / image-text-to-text, but the NemoClaw recipe never tested image input; whether the preview image serves it on sm_110 is unmeasured

restart stability: the recipe recorded one CUDA Xid 13 (illegal instruction) on restart with the serialized compile cache, worked around with VLLM_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1, explicitly not a restart soak — root cause unknown

mixed-length concurrent prefill OOM: upstream vLLM issue allocates a dense num_prefills x max_chunk PLE short-conv buffer; the recipe's 4-way mixed smoke passed with ~7.2 GiB available but is 'not a guarantee'
PLE read performance depends on NVMe: the recipe's Thor storage model is unstated; this Thor's WD SN5000S may read the PLE table slower or faster, which feeds decode tok/s directly

whether dropping every lobes lane frees enough for 0.90 on this Thor given the recipe's own ~7-10 GiB available-memory margin and this box's 7.3 GiB already-swapped pages; boot log KV capacity is authoritative
open_vagueness.resolution: moot: operator chose not to run the recipe; the Thor stays the worker host (2026-09-13)

scope_entries.finding: Thor lobes lanes may be stopped for the Flash-Next window and re-raised as needed; ssh thor@thor control granted

measured on a Thor 2026-09-05: 3-prompt coding probe, temp 0, thinking off, 512-token cap -> 34.98 tok/s mean (vs 24.97 Triton baseline); 19.58 GiB KV = 677,323 tokens; tool-call and 25,640-token retrieval smoke only; no full-256K request, no quality eval, no vision test

overlay 1 lifts vLLM's SM110 exclusion in flashinfer_cutlass_moe.py (refuses if gate text not found exactly once); overlay 2 ADDs 4 files from vllm@082cf021 and builds thor_gdn ops (build.py/install.py/patch_ple_io.py), sets VLLM_GDN_DECODE_KERNEL=cuda
no rule forbids an unpublished local image (lobes/vllm-gemma4:local precedent); registry pulls must be digest-pinned and source commits recorded
ahead_by 32; latest commit 2c5701d0 2026-09-13 notes patch 11 is temporary pending vllm#55513

both specs exported, execution deferred 2026-08-27 before stage 1; nothing ever booted; the NVFP4 was ruled out on footprint and the GGUF-via-vllm-gguf-plugin route chosen on paper; success bar there: >=25 tok/s single-stream at MAXN (~2x cortex's 12.1)

126.0 GiB, 419 files, many model-plefp8-*.safetensors shards (4.84 GiB each); arch Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration, vision_config present, 48 layers, 512 experts, mtp_num_hidden_layers 1, max_position_embeddings 262144; ungated
